events.title: V2.2.2 Patch Notes
events.summary: Thank you for your support, players!The key highlights of this update (V2.2.2) are as follows:Fixed the issue of certain characters flickering in various levels.Added the missing sound effects for correct placements in Level 2.Added the level-completion animation for Level 4.Made the crib in Level 8 appear in the correct position.Standardized character colors across all levels.Optimized the animation stutter when characters get up in Level 10.Improved the continuity of actions across all levels.
